name: PSAppDeployToolkit
description: PSAppDeployToolkit is a PowerShell-based, open-source framework for Windows software deployment that integrates with major deployment solutions (including Microsoft Intune). It provides a prescriptive deployment workflow, a rich library of functions, a customizable UI (Fluent or Classic), and full-fidelity logging to drive high deployment success rates. It enables complex, secure, user-friendly deployments across enterprise environments.
author: PSAppDeployToolkit

securityCheck.aiSummary: No malicious or exfiltration patterns detected in the provided code beyond a normal build pipeline concern. The toolkit primarily contains build orchestration logic for Intune deployment tooling. The notable risk is the use of ExecutionPolicy Bypass in build.cmd, which should be mitigated through signed scripts and restricted CI environments.
